document.abstract: This standard specifies the Composition Playlist (CPL) for the Interoperable Master Format (IMF). The Composition Playlist is a representation of a single version of a finished IMF composition (feature, episode, trailer, advertisement, etc). It contains the information necessary to describe the composition and synchronize its underlying essence; e.g., for playout or transcoding. It is an extensible, human-readable structure designed for file-based operations.
